Chairman’s Statement


2024 marks the 95th anniversary of China Taiping’s establishment and a pivotal year for achieving the objectives
of the 14th Five-Year Plan. Confronted with a complex and challenging external environment, all China Taiping
employees responded with composure and determination, driving progress in transforming growth models,
adjusting structures, improving quality, and enhancing efficiency. We remained focused on our core responsibilities,
steadily advanced the implementation of the 14th Five-Year Plan, and delivered high-quality operational results,
achieving the strongest financial performance in recent years.

Comprehensive Improvement in Operational Quality and Efficiency. The Group ’s total assets exceeded
HK$1.7 trillion, growing by 14.9% compared to the 2023 year-end. Profit attributable to shareholders reached
HK$8.432 billion, grew by 36.2% over the Last Year. The insurance sector maintained steady growth in scale
while significantly improving business quality. Insurance revenue and insurance service results sustained robust
growth momentum. TPL saw a notable rise in new business contribution to CSM, with new business value
rebounding to HK$10 billion platform, increased by 94.2%, reaching a record high. The persistency ratios for
bancassurance and individual agency channel led the industry for twelve consecutive years, and the transition
towards participating products progressed resolutely. P&C insurance and reinsurance achieved optimisation in
combined ratios over the Last Year, maintaining underwriting profitability. TPP’s new business contribution to CSM
grew by 37.0% over the Last Year. The investment sector demonstrated stable progress, with investment income
rebounding significantly. Both the Group’s managed investment assets and Group’s insurance fund investment
assets expanded. Total investment income grew by 98.2% compared to 2023, and the comprehensive investment
yield improved markedly over the Last Year.

Delivering Effective Services to National Strategies. Advancing the “Five Target Areas” to Support the
Real Economy and Safeguard the People’s Livelihood. Technology Finance: Premiums of strategic emerging
industries grew over the Last Year, investments in innovation surged, tech insurance products diversified, and
our cybersecurity insurance solution was selected as a pilot product by the Ministry of Industry and Information
Technology. Green Finance: Green insurance premiums and investments expanded rapidly, achieving a full
coverage of the five major central power enterprises. The Group has also successfully joined the Green Shipping
Community and the Maritime Community. Inclusive Finance: Coverage of critical illness insurance, Hui Min Bao（ 惠
民保）, long-term care insurance, and small and micro enterprises insured continued to rise. TPG, with CTIH as
a core subsidiary, was awarded the highest grade in the Evaluation of Targeted Poverty Alleviation Performance
among centrally administered state-owned units for three consecutive years. Ageing Finance: The second pillar
annuity fund net assets increased by HK$66.088 billion, the development of the third-pillar business achieved
new breakthroughs, and the individual pension premiums increase significantly over the Last Year. The first public
pension fund product was set up and included in the “Individual Pension Fund Directory”. Digital Finance: AI and
big data technologies were widely applied in operations. Data governance and data security are being steadily
promoted. Information systems related to the new international accounting standards, overseas P&C core
platforms, and risk reduction information systems are continuously improved, forming a digital financial service
model integrating “Insurance, Technology, and Services”.

Active Participation in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area (GBA) Development. In 2024,
the Group generated premium income of HK$60.165 billion in the GBA, serving over 7 million effective individual
customers and 150 thousand group customers in the region. Investment scale in the GBA surged to HK$124.5
billion. We focused on “ Cross-border Protection ” , launching the cross-border collaborative product “ Infinite
Legacy” across Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Singapore. Our leadership in cross-border vehicle insurance was
further solidified. The Group officially took over the operation of the Hengqin Traditional Chinese Medicine Science
and Technology Industrial Park of Co-operation between Guangdong and Macau, significantly improving overall
occupancy rates and fostering industrial clustering.




       China Taiping Insurance Holdings Company Limited
  8    2024 Annual Report
董事長致辭


                                  2024年 是 中 國 太 平 創 立95周 年，也 是 實 現
                                 「十四五」規劃目標任務的關鍵一年。面對複雜
                                  嚴峻的外部環境，全體太平人沉著應對、迎難
                                  而上，在轉方式、調結構、提質量、增效益上積
                                  極進取，堅持目標導向，抓實主責主業，穩步推
                                  進「十四五」規劃落地，高質量完成全年經營任
                                  務，取得了近年來最好的經營業績。

                                  經營發展質效全面提升。集團總資產突破1.7萬
                                  億港元，較2023年末增長14.9%；股東應佔溢
                                  利84.32億港元，同比增長36.2%。保險板塊規
                                  模穩步增長，業務品質大幅優化。保險服務收
                                  入、保險服務業績保持良好增長勢頭。太平人
                                  壽新業務貢獻合同服務邊際明顯提升，新業務
                                  價值重回百億台階，增長94.2%，創歷史新高，
                                  銀保、個險繼續率連續十二年行業領先，分紅
                                  險轉型步伐堅定。產險和再保險綜合成本率同
                                  比優化，保持承保盈利。太平養老新業務貢獻
                                  合同服務邊際同比增長37.0%。投資板塊業務
                                  穩中有進，投資收益顯著回升。集團管理投資
                                  資產與集團內保險資金投資資產規模均實現增
                                  長。實現總投資收益額較2023年增長98.2%。
                                  綜合投資收益率同比提升幅度較大。

                                  服務國家戰略卓有成效。奮力寫好「五篇大文
                YIN Zhaojun 尹兆君   章」
                                   ，支持實體經濟和保障社會民生力度加大。
                Chairman    董事長   科技金融方面，戰略性新興產業保費同比增長，
                                  科創領域投資規模快速增加，科技保險產品不
                                  斷豐富，網絡安全保險服務方案入圍工信部服
務試點。綠色金融方面，綠色保險保費、投資規模快速增長，實現對五大電力央企集團服務全覆蓋，成功加入綠色船

4    Key Assumptions                                                  4   主要假設

     TPL has adopted the best estimate approach in setting the            太平人壽在設定計算內含價值及新業務價
     assumptions used in the calculation of its Embedded Value            值之假設時乃採納最佳估計方法。有關假
     and New Business Value. The assumptions have been based              設乃基於太平人壽之實際經驗，及參照中
     on the actual experience of TPL and certain benchmarks set           國之整體經濟狀況及其他壽險公司之經驗
     by referencing general PRC economic conditions and the               而設定之若干基準。
     experience of other life insurance companies.

     4.1 Risk discount rate                                               4.1 風險貼現率

         The risk discount rate represents the long-term, post-             風險貼現率乃指接受估值之投資者之
         tax cost of capital of the investor for whom the valuation         稅後長期資本成本，同時慮及中國有
         is made, together with an allowance for risk, taking into          關政治經濟環境等因素對風險作出調
         account of factors such as the political and economic              整。
         environment in the PRC.

         As calculated, the discount rate is equal to the risk-free         計算時，貼現率乃按無風險利率加風
         rate plus a risk premium. The risk free rate is based on           險溢價計算。無風險利率乃基於中國
         the PRC ten-year government bond and the risk premium              10年政府債券，而風險溢價反映與未
         reflects the risk associated with future cash flows,               來現金流有關之風險，包括所有在估
         including all of the risks which have not been considered          值時未有慮及之風險。
         in the valuation.

         The risk discount rate currently applied by TPL is 8.5%             太平人壽現時就其所有有效業務及新
         (2023: 9.0%) for all in force and new business.                     業 務 所 採 納 之 風 險 貼 現 率 均 為8.5%
                                                                            （2023年：9.0%） 。

     4.2 Investment return                                                4.2 投資回報

         The annual investment returns have been assumed to be               假設未來年度每年投資回報率為4.0%
         4.0% (2023: annual investment returns assumed to be                （2023年：假設未來年度每年投資回報
         4.5%).                                                              率為4.5%）
                                                                                   。

     4.3 Expenses                                                         4.3 費用

         Expenses have been projected based on benchmark                    費用乃根據基準假設而預計。
         assumptions.

     4.4 Tax                                                              4.4 稅項

         The tax rate is assumed to be 25% according to the tax             根據中國稅法規定，稅率為25%。
         regulations of the PRC.

II.   The Three Lines of Defense for the Comprehensive                  二、 公司全面風險管理的三道防線
      Risk Management Framework

      management organisation system in which decisions are               責任的全面風險管理組織體系。其中風
      made by and the ultimate responsibility is assumed by the           險管理委員會為董事會決策提供支持，

      management practices, the Risk Management Department                稽核負責監督。
      takes the lead and organises each work, every functional

               available to settle liabilities when due.                                    險。

               general strategies of liquidity management to ensure that                    及一般策略管理該風險，以確保本集

               circumstances and that an adequate stock of high-quality                     充裕的高質素流動資產，以應對可能
               liquid assets is maintained in order to contain the possibility              產生的流動資金危機。
               of a liquidity crisis.

               Apart from liquidity management and regulatory compliance,                   除流動資金管理及監管遵從外，本集
               the Group always strives to maintain a comfortable liquidity                 團致力於留存適度的流動資金緩衝額
               cushion as a safety net for coping with unexpected large                     作為應對意料之外的大筆資金需求的
               funding requirements and to maintain a contingency plan to                   安全措施，以及制定應急計劃以應付
               be enacted should there be a company specific crisis.                        公司的特定危機。

     HKFRS 19 Subsidiaries without Public Accountability:                                香港財務報告準則第19號「非公共受托責任子公
     Disclosures                                                                         司的披露」

     HKFRS 19 simplifies financial reporting by allowing eligible                         香港財務報告準則第19號允許合資格的子公司
     subsidiaries to apply and hence assert compliance with HKFRSs                        採用以簡化財務報告，因此以較少的披露確保
     with reduced disclosures.                                                            符合香港財務報告準則。

     A subsidiary may elect to apply HKFRS 19 in its consolidated,                        於報告日，如符合下列情況，子公司可選擇應
     separate or individual financial statements provided that, at the                    用香港財務報告準則第19號於其綜合、單獨或
     reporting date:                                                                      個別財務報表田：

     •    it does not have public accountability; and                                     •   它不負有公共受托責任；及
